resources.string:
"~ PocketArrows ~ A StepMania-compatible rhythm game for Android. Tap the falling arrows to the beat, or use osu! Mod to tap circles.
New players should start on Easy. Some downloaded charts are meant for hardcore StepMania players.
~ Songs ~ Use SELECT SONG to pick a chart. Copy StepMania packs into the Beats/Songs folder on internal storage. DOWNLOAD SONGS opens a public stepfile index.
Supported formats: .sm (StepMania 3.9), .dwi, and partial .osu.
~ Play ~ Wait until notes reach the receptors, then tap. MENU or the on-screen BACK button pauses or exits a song.
Check SETTINGS for scroll speed, song speed, tapbox layout, and modifiers. "

"PocketArrows 2.1.0 - PocketArrows branding, logo, splash, and intro video - Song speed and free-form scroll speed - Song select banners, note count, NPS, best score - Hardware SurfaceView / display refresh - Multitouch drag column updates - On-screen BACK control
Based on the open-source Beats 1.7.5b code by Keripo. "
